result.instructions: Tools for Getform, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the latest 10 submissions of my contact form."; "Which form submissions came in this week, and what did people ask about?"; "Find the submission from info@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Getform data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run getform_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run getform_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run getform_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. getform_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: getform_list_submissions
tools.title: List form submissions
tools.description: List the submissions of one Getform (Forminit) form, one page at a time: id, date, status (open/closed/spam) and every submitted answer (sender name/email/phone and fields). This is personal data: use query, a small size, or include_answers=false when you need less. Needs a paid Getform plan (the read API). GET /v1/forms/{formId}.

form_id.description: The form id (the last part of the form's endpoint URL). Default: the form you entered at sign-in.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

query.description: Only submissions that contain this keyword, e.g. an email address.

include_answers.description: Return the sender details and answers of each submission (default true). Pass false to get only id, date and status.

include_files.description: Also return file attachment metadata and download links (default false).

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the dates, e.g. Europe/London (default UTC).

tools.name: getform_submit_form
tools.title: Submit a form entry
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new submission on a Getform (Forminit) form, as if a visitor had filled it in. The form's own workflow then runs: notification emails, autoresponder to the sender's email, webhooks, Slack, Google Sheets. It counts against the plan's monthly submissions and can not be undone from here. Use it only when the user asked for a submission, and with the data the user gave. Never retried. POST /f/{formId}. Returns only the new submission's id and date.

form_id.description: The form id (the last part of the form's endpoint URL). Default: the form you entered at sign-in.

sender.description: Who is submitting. Getform needs at least one of email, fullName, firstName, lastName or phone.

fields.description: Field blocks; every name must be unique. File uploads are not supported.

type.description: Block type: text, number, email, phone (E.164), url, date (ISO 8601), rating (1-5), select/radio/checkbox, country (ISO alpha-2).

value.description: The value; select and checkbox also take a list of strings.
